from common import *
import statistics,traceback

def run_stage(name,argv):
    progress=read(PROGRESS);progress['pipeline_stage']=name;write(PROGRESS,progress)
    with (TMP/f'pipeline-{name}.log').open('w') as log:
        r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-u',*argv],cwd=ROOT,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    if r.returncode==75:return False
    if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(f'{name} exit{r.returncode}; see pipeline log')
    print('completed stage',name,flush=True)
    return True

def main():
    save_source(__file__)
    assert not any(j['status']=='running' for j in read(PROGRESS)['jobs'])
    for variant in VARIANTS:
        progress=read(PROGRESS);status=progress['scientific_candidates'][variant]['status']
        if status=='completed':continue
        if status in ['planned','running']:
            harness('check')
            elapsed=[j['finished_at']-j['started_at'] for j in progress['jobs'] if j['status']=='succeeded']
            per_fit=max(660,statistics.median(elapsed)) if elapsed else 660
            check(progress['source_amendment'])
            count=5
            count-=sum(j['variant']==variant and j['status']=='succeeded' for j in progress['jobs'])
            remain=read(STATE)['deadline']-time.time()
            estimate=count*per_fit+1800+2700
            write(BASE/'docs'/f'budget-before-{variant}.json',{'remaining_seconds':remain,'estimated_fit_wall_seconds':count*per_fit,'evaluation_reserve_seconds':1800,'closeout_reserve_seconds':2700,'start_allowed':remain>=estimate})
            if remain<estimate:
                progress['status']='budget_stop_pending_closeout';write(PROGRESS,progress);print('budget reserve stops expansion',variant,flush=True);return
            if not run_stage('train-'+variant,[str(TMP/'train_group_single.py'),variant]):return
        assert not any(j['status']=='running' for j in read(PROGRESS)['jobs'])
        for year in range(2020,2027):
            proof=BASE/'docs'/f'inference-{variant}-{year}.json'
            if proof.exists():
                for item in read(proof)['predictions']:check(item['prediction_part'])
                continue
            run_stage(f'infer-{variant}-{year}',[str(TMP/'infer.py'),variant,str(year)])
        if read(PROGRESS)['scientific_candidates'][variant]['status']!='evaluated_awaiting_registration':
            run_stage('evaluate-'+variant,[str(TMP/'evaluate_single.py'),variant])
        run_stage('publish-'+variant,[str(TMP/'publish_single_v2.py')])
        run_stage('plot-'+variant,[str(TMP/'plot_single.py')])
    progress=read(PROGRESS);progress['status']='evaluation_complete_awaiting_review';progress['pipeline_finished_at']=time.time();write(PROGRESS,progress)
    print('All six scientific candidates evaluated and registered; final verification/cleanup remain.',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':
    try:main()
    except BaseException as e:
        out=BASE/'docs'/('pipeline-failure-'+str(int(time.time()))+'.json');write(out,{'error':repr(e),'traceback':traceback.format_exc(),'stage':read(PROGRESS).get('pipeline_stage'),'at':time.time()})
        print('Pipeline stopped:',repr(e),flush=True);raise
